description: This file defines an Angular page component for displaying detailed information about a specific speaker, including biography, social links, and associated sessions. It imports other UI components and services, utilizes reactive programming to fetch data asynchronously, and renders the data within a template.

classes.name: SpeakerDetailPage
classes.description: An Angular component that presents detailed information about a selected speaker, including their biography, social links, and related sessions. It loads data based on route parameters and combines results from speakers and sessions services.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component and injects dependencies such as ActivatedRoute, SpeakersService, and SessionsService.

methods.name: vm$
methods.description: An observable that retrieves the speaker's data and associated sessions based on the route parameter 'id', combining data from the speakers and sessions services, and handling the case when a speaker is not found.
